required_acl.PIN: Explicit auth flag + maxAttempts11; immutable/no delete or rebind; full platform SCP03
required_acl.CREDIT: Only PIN-authenticated native session may WRITE; platform may READ only
required_acl.ERASE: Monotonic nonzero latch refuses ordinary access; survives until qualified ALL-DATA wipe
required_acl.MARKER: Written LAST; no runtime WRITE/DELETE; digest is not an ACL proof
required_acl.ALL_PRIVATE_OBJECTS: Explicit PIN AuthID policy, no default/all-other-user private operations

native_userid_counter_readback: Not a retry counter: AN12413 3.2.4.4 says UserID reports zero
userid_read_size: Not supported; never used as a length/PIN-strength proof
migration: No automatic migration from legacy HKDF v2; full verified destruction first
